name: MMBench_test
description: Test set of MMBench, a bilingual benchmark for assessing multi-modal capabilities of vision-language models through multiple-choice questions in both English and Chinese, providing systematic evaluation across diverse vision-language tasks.
reputation: Widely used multimodal benchmark from Shanghai AI Laboratory; official test split requires submission for evaluation to prevent leakage; cited in major model releases
notes: The test set requires submission to the official evaluation server to prevent data leakage. The benchmark covers 20 ability dimensions including attribute recognition, celebrity recognition, OCR, scene understanding, and spatial relationships. A bilingual (EN/ZH) version (MMBench-CN) also exists.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
